recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中混有許多中型母細胞，核不規則、染色質細，胞質灰藍無顆粒並有偏心突起，部分細胞膜下可見小空泡排列；背景仍有成熟嗜中性球與紅血球前驅細胞，型態符合 BPDCN 浸潤。
features: Medium-sized blasts with irregular, oval to indented nuclei and fine chromatin
Moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm, some with eccentric tail-like projections
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles aligned beneath the cell membrane
Arrow marks a larger cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a round nucleus
Background residual hematopoiesis: segmented and band neutrophils, erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population in which numerous medium-sized blasts are admixed with residual maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors. The blasts have irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm, some with unipolar projections and small submembranous vacuoles. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCF4+, MPO-negative).

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts show fine azurophilic granules, NSE positivity and CD14/CD64/lysozyme expression, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular, NSE-negative and CD123/TCF4/TCL1 positive.
MDS shows dysplasia across lineages with fewer blasts (<20%) that are usually CD34+ myeloblasts, not CD4+CD56+CD123 bright plasmacytoid dendritic cells.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Mature pDC nodules/aggregates are CD56-negative with low Ki-67 and accompany CMML or AML, unlike the CD56+ blastic infiltrate of BPDCN.
